title: Parallel Infrastructure

tasks.description: Create parallel package - set up @mathts/parallel package structure with workerpool integration
ComputePool class - create main parallel execution manager wrapping workerpool
Worker lifecycle management - implement worker creation, reuse, and termination
Task chunking strategies - implement chunk-based parallelization for large arrays
Matrix worker implementation - create dedicated worker for matrix operations
Transferable object handling - implement zero-copy ArrayBuffer transfer to workers
Parallel infrastructure tests - test worker pool, chunking, and data transfer

successCriteria: Task chunking divides work evenly across workers
notes: Sprint 9 completes the parallel execution infrastructure. The @mathts/parallel package wraps @mathts/workerpool with a ComputePool class providing automatic parallelization based on data size. Features include: task chunking strategies (calculateOptimalChunks, chunkFloat64Array, partition2D), comprehensive parallel operations (sum, dot, matmul, transpose, elementwise ops, statistical ops, unary ops), worker lifecycle management, and zero-copy ArrayBuffer transfer via Transfer wrapper. All 97 parallel tests pass including 31 chunk tests and 66 ComputePool tests.
